description.zh-CN: 桌面系统通知 / Webhook 推送（SSRF 防线、限超时）

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Send a notification with title + body. Channels (exactly one): channel "desktop" shows a system notification on this machine; channel "webhook" POSTs {title, body, source} as JSON to url (http/https only; private/loopback addresses refused by the SSRF guard, redirects not followed; non-2xx counts as failed delivery). Args: channel, title (max 200 chars), body (max 2000 chars), url (webhook only), timeout_secs (default 10, max 60).

url.description: absolute http(s) URL; required for webhook channel
